name: Text

sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: Logical byte pointer and length; a 16-byte descriptor in the current layout. Ownership belongs to the retained bytes.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: Quoted/raw/multiline literals; byteLength, codepointCount and typed textual methods.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: The descriptor refers to retained UTF-8 text data. Derived views remain bound to the owner lifetime; release child views before their parent. Binding a descriptor does not authorize mutation or extend borrowed storage. Explicit textual/byte operations preserve their documented byte or scalar units.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Use x86_64 Linux System V ELF for the executed examples. Incompatible types reject before publication; bounds and ownership checks precede an invalid read, mutation or drop. Internal descriptor layouts are not portable ABI promises.

summary: Immutable UTF-8 text with explicit byte, scalar and grapheme units.
